name: antidote
description: Checks your MCP configs, agent skills and prompts against the Antidote database of malicious and vulnerable AI agent artifacts.

commands.title: Antidote: Scan my agent setup (Claude, Cursor, Gemini…)

antidote.path.description: Path to the antidote binary. Empty: use one on PATH, or download the release build.

antidote.scanOnSave.description: Re-scan the workspace when an MCP config, skill or prompt file is saved.

antidote.noClassifier.description: Skip the offline prompt-injection classifier (faster, fewer findings on prose).
